$comment: Single source of truth for module status. docs/build-readiness.md is GENERATED from this file by scripts/generate-readiness.mjs, and CI fails if the two disagree. A hand-maintained status table drifts silently — this one did, for eleven commits, because a formatter realigned its columns and every subsequent string edit no-opped without complaint.

modules.name: Architecture freeze
modules.note: System context, component map, data flow, ADRs 0001-0004, ownership

modules.name: Monorepo foundation
modules.note: pnpm workspace, TS strict, Foundry, compose, config package, layering and bundle-scan gates

modules.name: Domain, predicate, state machine
modules.note: Safety predicate, state machine, 22 reason codes; 27/27 mutants killed

modules.name: Evidence journal and projections
modules.note: Append-only journal with trigger enforcement, canonical hashing, rebuildable projections

modules.name: xStocks API client
modules.note: Built against the verified live OpenAPI v2 contract; 4 live contract tests

modules.name: X Layer reader and indexer
modules.note: Block-stamped reads plus a finalized adapter-event indexer with durable cursors, fenced writes, reorg detection, append-only compensation, and replay tests

modules.name: Canonical asset/wrapper registry
modules.note: Six-check matrix with PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN per row, registry diffing

modules.name: Reconciler and recovery
modules.note: Deterministic reconciler, fenced auto-renewing leases, incident dedup, lifecycle recovery, and a polling worker that records API/chain comparison per asset

modules.name: Operation digest and EIP-712 receipt
modules.note: Ten bound fields, mutation-tested; golden vectors shared with Solidity and the SDK

modules.name: Solidity TESTNET FIXTURE
modules.note: Asset, wrapper, legacy wrapper; 21 tests including fuzz on nonce monotonicity. The current v2 implementation is not deployed

modules.name: ActionGuardAdapter and ProtectedVault
modules.note: 35 adversarial tests; digest proven identical to TypeScript. The current v2 adapter and pause-safe vault are not deployed

modules.name: Fastify API and OpenAPI contract
modules.note: Ten routes, strict request/query validation, durable authentication and idempotency, and OpenAPI generated from runtime schemas

modules.name: Web design system and shell
modules.note: Semantic tokens, shell, status primitives; 28 WCAG pairs verified in CI

modules.name: Coverage dashboard
modules.note: Renders live evidence; verified against a running API and against a killed one

modules.name: Asset detail and timeline
modules.note: Detail page with canonicality, multiplier epoch, provenance, per-field source comparison, and a replayed evidence timeline

modules.name: Preflight Lab and testnet execution
modules.note: Preflight Lab now builds and submits the exact adapter transaction with wallet status feedback; it is intentionally disabled until a compatible v2 deployment exists

modules.name: Incident replay and review console
modules.note: Incident list ordered by deterministic severity, plus deterministic replay from immutable journal rows with a policy-version warning

modules.name: AI incident explainer
modules.note: Isolated explainer: citation validation, runbook allowlist, injection delimiting, and a deliberately-good deterministic fallback. No provider wired. Architecture test proves it cannot reach the money path

modules.name: Integrator SDK and CLI
modules.note: Typed client, local verifier, exact adapter-call encoder and wallet-ready transaction builder, plus a guard CLI with meaningful exit codes

modules.name: Observability and fault injection
modules.note: Redaction, structured logging, metrics, and xStocks fault injection are implemented; several declared RPC/database/signer scenarios are not wired end to end

modules.name: Security hardening and threat model
modules.note: Threat model with per-row test references and recorded residual risks

modules.name: CI, containers, deployment
modules.note: Seven-job CI, non-root multi-stage images verified by real builds, full compose stack, a mechanical web-secret boundary check, and deployment/rollback docs

modules.name: End-to-end proof and submission package
modules.note: Historical v1 release evidence has real transaction hashes for 8/8 scenarios; the changed v2 contracts require a fresh deployment and proof run

modules.name: Final independent audit
modules.note: The repository contains an internal review only. No independent security audit has been performed
